dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of four parallel, vertical high-intensity linear marks on the anterior dorsal-lateral region; a distinct, isolated 'Y' or 'V' shaped high-intensity pixel cluster in the mid-dorsal region; and a large, diffuse high-intensity area on the lower posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the anterior shoulder streaks, the central 'Y' mark, and the posterior-lateral light cluster form an obtuse scalene triangle across the visible dorsal-lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly specific set of parallel linear high-contrast markings located on the anterior dorsal-lateral shoulder area.
